title: Strategic commands
description: One command set a faction controller returns for every hour that passes: the same commands a player issues. They resolve together with the player's actions (STR-003). The strategic layer validates and resolves them; a valid offerContract reaches Management as a management_requests contractOffer request (STR-044), not through this interface. Spec: STR-003, STR-020, STR-021, STR-044, STR-070, STR-094, STR-096, SAI-004, SAI-011, SAI-014..SAI-017.

log.description: Decision log: time, faction, tier, chosen option, top-N options with per-consideration scores (SAI-011)

squad.description: setGoal, moveSquad, hold, scout, attack: an own squad; answerEscort: the Krug squad attached when accepting

squads.description: acceptContract: squads assigned to the accepted contract (SAI-015)

contractId.description: acceptContract: the id of the offer taken (an entry of the view's contractOffers)

target.description: setGoal: region, POI, squad or the player; attack: a foreign squad or POI on the squad's tile; recruit: the held tile where the squad is raised (STR-096)

escortFor.description: hireEscort: the own shipment (convoy squad, on a Krug-market tile and not yet left) a Krug squad escorts (STR-094)

route.description: hireEscort: the convoy's planned tile path to its destination; sets the price (STR-094)

requestId.description: answerEscort: the id of an entry of the Krug view's escortRequests (SAI-017)

accept.description: answerEscort: true accepts (squad then names the Krug squad attached), false refuses

measure.description: pickMeasure: one of the view's availableMeasures (STR-070)

id.description: Offer ID, unique per campaign; acceptContract.contractId and MGT refer to it

targetFaction.description: The faction the missions act against, if any (reputation acts, MGT-056)

sourceGoal.description: The STR-018 goal the offer serves

key.description: Per-mission key, unique within the offer (two missions of one type are told apart by it)

reputationGain.description: Deprecated, optional: MGT-056 now derives the reputation gain per mission from its pay band; kept for compatibility (management_requests holds an identical copy)

reputationGate.description: MGT-055 contract flags set by the offering faction: better = Friendly or better only, sensitive = Trusted only
